evidence: Batch 3 outcome-aware scale 0.5 avoided visible-intent shaping but K/L remained high-entropy and nearly eliminated resource-seeking in held-out evaluation.
The best K/L original return came from herd/rest behavior, while forage remained below 1.3 events per episode and water was zero.
motivation.change: Increase only the coefficient on verified post-transition drive improvement from 0.5 to 2.0; retain the same outcome gate, features, scenarios, simulator, and A2C controls.
motivation.selection: No training reward is used for ranking; evaluate every candidate against all historical and new references on identical unseen worlds with original reward.

limitations: The scale increase is an exploratory signal-strength ablation and can still bias policy optimization.
Only original-simulator held-out outcomes determine acceptance; a failure ends the authorized 24-run budget.
No biological validity or husbandry claim is supported.
